title: Profile
signOutBody: You'll need your mobile number and password to sign in again.
displayNameHint: Optional. Shown on leaderboards instead of your name.
languageSyncFailed: Language changed on this phone. It will be saved to your account next time.

password.note: After the change you will be signed out on every device, including this one.
password.done: Password changed. Please sign in with your new password.

pushHint: Get a reminder before an exam starts and important notices from us.
pushDenied: Notifications are blocked for this app. Turn them on in your phone's settings.
pushError: Could not turn on notifications. Check your internet and try again.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.warning: This cannot be undone. Your account is deleted for good and you are signed out on every phone.

points.erased: Your name, mobile number, e-mail and nickname are erased.
points.signedOut: You are signed out everywhere and cannot sign in again with this account.
points.kept: Your exam results and payment records are kept without your name, so other students' merit positions and our accounting records stay correct.
points.again: You can register again later with the same number as a new account; nothing from this one comes back.

delete.passwordHint: Enter your password to confirm it is you.
delete.confirmBody: Your account and personal details will be deleted now. This cannot be undone.
